tools.name: get_tool_help
tools.description: Describe one tool visible on this facade, including its exact contract, or return a bounded workflow overview for one supported topic.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Choose data or geometry to list published pack IDs or family and scope IDs. The response includes a complete catalog download URL. Use get_pack for data or get_geography for geometry. Current catalog: The same geography tools work worldwide across a cataloged baseline of 252 geographic entities, rea

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Narrow one data pack before get_data. With only pack_id, lists the pack's sources and their coverage. Add source_id to list that source's metrics (name, unit, years, aggregation) and its filterable and sortable fields; search to match metrics across the pack by name, description, or keyword; or metr

tools.name: get_geography
tools.description: Inspect one published geometry family across scopes or one scope across families. Returns coverage and known editions from catalog metadata only. Optional year selects the latest admitted edition no later than that year when the selected catalog has an edition index; an unavailable index is reported

tools.name: get_loc_id_info
tools.description: Look up one known loc_id or up to 10 loc_ids within the same country or reference scope in the selected reference graph. For international datasets, group identifiers by their owning country or reference scope and submit separate calls. Mixed-scope batches can be slow or time out. Return its identit

tools.name: compare_geographies
tools.description: Compare two known loc_ids using selected reference-graph identity and direct relationship evidence. A pair may span countries or reference scopes where the selected graph supports the comparison. For batches, group pairs by the same country or the same pair of reference scopes and submit separate ca

tools.name: get_shape
tools.description: Shape lookup for exact existing loc_ids only. The default returns shape availability, centroid, and bounding box; include_polygon=true adds GeoJSON coordinates. Obtain any descendant IDs before this call. Historical geometry is returned first and successors are never substituted automatically. Year

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "boundaries?registry=mcpregistry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: get_loc_id_info, compare_geographies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: get_loc_id_info, compare_geographies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_loc_id_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up one known loc_id or a small batch in the selected reference graph. Return its identity and directly recorded loc_id connections, with family, direction, and relationship evidence. Each ID returns at most 50 connections and an explicit has_more flag. For international datasets, group identifiers by their owning country or reference scope and submit separate calls. Mixed-scope batches can be slow or time out. Return its identit"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
